provenance.paper_title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning

representation_paths.memory_component: environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge stores

evidence.paraphrase: Four typed stores retain object states, activities, procedures, and regularities.
Online editing maintains object identities and state histories. For MEMORA, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge stores.
Offline consolidation forms reusable procedures. For MEMORA, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge stores.

Repeated experience is abstracted into procedures and participant-specific regularities. For MEMORA, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge stores.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge stores) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
